knowledge:
- key_parameters: whippetDataSet=The Whippet dataset object containing splicing events ;; probability=Minimum probability threshold for filtering significant Whippet events ;; psiDelta=Minimum change in PSI (Percent Spliced In) for filtering Whippet events ;; eventTypes=Types of splicing events to filter (e.g., "CE", "RI", "AA", "AD", "AF", "AL", or "all") ;; minCounts=Mean of at least this many counts in one condition to filter Whippet events ;; NMD=Logical indicating whether to predict and filter by nonsense-mediated decay potential (requires the notNMD package) ;; match=Character string (e.g., "skip" or "exact") specifying how to match exons for skipping ;; glueExons=Logical indicating whether to glue exons together when retaining an intron ;; filterNMD=Logical indicating whether to remove NMD-targeted frames/isoforms where possible ;; compareBy=Character string (e.g., "gene") specifying the grouping level for comparison
- alternatives: The external GitHub package notNMD is mentioned and used for predicting nonsense-mediated decay (NMD) potential (via predictNMD) ;; Whippet, Leafcutter, and DEXSeq are supported upstream tools for differential splicing analysis
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have identified differentially spliced events from Whippet, Leafcutter, or DEXSeq and want to analyze their functional impact on the proteome, such as changes in ORF length, frame shifts, NMD target status, or UTR lengths.
- pitfalls: Creating alternative donor, acceptor, first, or last isoforms currently relies on junction read counts supplied specifically by Whippet ;; Predicting NMD potential requires the external package notNMD and upstream ORF annotations ;; GTF files must have consistent annotations (e.g., "exon" and "transcript" types) and may need pre-filtering or re-annotation (like adding first_last annotations to speed up processing).

workflows.name: whippet_analysis
workflows.intent: Import, filter, and analyze Whippet alternative splicing events, generate in silico alternative isoforms, and annotate/compare their open reading frames (ORFs).
workflows.stages: 1. Read Whippet dataset using readWhippetDataSet ;; 2. Import GTF and prepare exon/transcript annotations ;; 3. Filter Whippet events using filterWhippetEvents ;; 4. Summarize transcript changes using whippetTranscriptChangeSummary ;; 5. Model specific splicing events (e.g., Exon Skipping with findExonContainingTranscripts and skipExonInTranscript, or Intron Retention with findIntronContainingTranscripts and addIntronInTranscript, or Alternative Splice Sites/First/Last Exons with findJunctionPairs and replaceJunction) ;; 6. Annotate ORFs using getOrfs and upstream ORFs using getUOrfs ;; 7. Compare ORFs between isoforms using orfDiff ;; 8. Annotate gene models for visualization using annotateGeneModel
workflows.code:
wds <- readWhippetDataSet(whippet_file_directory)
whippet_sampleTable <- data.frame(sample=c("A01","B01","A21","B21"),
                                  condition=c("01","01","21","21"),
                                  replicate=(c("A","B","A","B")))
gtf <- rtracklayer::import(system.file("extdata","example_gtf.gtf", 
package = "GeneStructureTools"))
exons <- gtf[gtf$type=="exon"]
transcripts <- gtf[gtf$type=="transcript"]
if(!("first_last" %in% colnames(mcols(exons)))){
    t <- as.data.frame(table(exons$transcript_id))
    exons$first_last <- NA
    exons$first_last[exons$exon_number == 1] <- "first"
    exons$first_last[exons$exon_number == 
    t$Freq[match(exons$transcript_id, t$Var1)]] <- "last"
}
g <- BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10::BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10
wds <- filterWhippetEvents(
whippetDataSet = wds,
probability = 0.95, # min probability
psiDelta = 0.1, # min change in PSI
eventTypes = "all", # all event types
minCounts = 100, # mean of at least 100 counts in one condition
sampleTable = whippet_sampleTable)
whippet_summary <- whippetTranscriptChangeSummary(wds,
exons = exons,
transcripts = transcripts,
BSgenome = g,
NMD = FALSE # ignore nonsense mediated decay
)
wds.ce <- filterWhippetEvents(wds, psiDelta=0,probability=0, 
event="CE", idList="ENSMUSG00000024038.16")
diffSplicingResults(wds.ce)
coordinates(wds.ce)
exons.ce <- findExonContainingTranscripts(wds.ce, 
                                          exons = exons,
                                          transcripts = transcripts)
skippedExonTranscripts <- skipExonInTranscript(skippedExons = exons.ce,
                                               exons=exons, 
                                               match="skip",
                                               whippetDataSet = wds.ce)
wds.ri <- filterWhippetEvents(wds, psiDelta=0,probability=0, 
event="RI", idList="ENSMUSG00000018379.17")
exons.ri <- findIntronContainingTranscripts(wds.ri, 
                                            exons)
retainedIntronTranscripts <- addIntronInTranscript(exons.ri, 
                                                   exons = exons, 
                                                   whippetDataSet = wds.ri,
                                                   glueExons = TRUE)
wds.aa <- filterWhippetEvents(wds, psiDelta=0,probability=0, 
event="AA", idList="ENSMUSG00000034064.14")
junctionPairs.aa <- findJunctionPairs(wds.aa, 
                                   type="AA")
altTranscripts <- replaceJunction(wds.aa, 
                                  junctionPairs.aa, 
                                  exons, 
                                  type="AA")
xTranscripts <- altTranscripts[altTranscripts$set=="AA_X"]
yTranscripts <- altTranscripts[altTranscripts$set=="AA_Y"]
normalTranscripts <- exons[exons$transcript_id %in% 
                                        exons.ce$transcript_id]
orfs_normal <- getOrfs(normalTranscripts, BSgenome = g, 
                       returnLongestOnly = FALSE, allFrames = TRUE)
orfs_skipped <- getOrfs(skippedExonTranscripts[skippedExonTranscripts$set == 
                                                                "skipped_exon"],
                        BSgenome = g,
                        returnLongestOnly = FALSE, allFrames = TRUE)
orfs_included <- getOrfs(skippedExonTranscripts[skippedExonTranscripts$set == 
                                                               "included_exon"],
                         BSgenome = g,
                        returnLongestOnly = FALSE, allFrames = TRUE)
upstreamORFs <- getUOrfs(normalTranscripts, BSgenome = g, orfs=orfs_normal, findExonB=TRUE)
orfs_normal <- getOrfs(normalTranscripts, BSgenome = g, 
                       returnLongestOnly = FALSE, allFrames = TRUE,
                       uORFs=TRUE)
orfChange <- orfDiff(orfsX = orfs_included, 
                     orfsY = orfs_skipped, 
                     filterNMD = FALSE,
                     compareBy="gene",
                     geneSimilarity = TRUE,
                     compareUTR=TRUE,
                     allORFs = orfs_normal)
geneModel.skipped <- annotateGeneModel(skippedExonTranscripts[
    skippedExonTranscripts$set=="skipped_exon"], orfs_skipped)
geneModel.included <- annotateGeneModel(skippedExonTranscripts[
    skippedExonTranscripts$set=="included_exon"], orfs_included)

workflows.name: leafcutter_analysis
workflows.intent: Import Leafcutter intron results, summarize transcript changes, and generate alternative isoforms based on intron usage clusters.
workflows.stages: 1. Import GTF and extract exons ;; 2. Read Leafcutter intron results ;; 3. Summarize transcript changes using leafcutterTranscriptChangeSummary ;; 4. Select a cluster and generate alternative isoforms using alternativeIntronUsage
workflows.code:
gtf <- rtracklayer::import(system.file("extdata","example_gtf.gtf", package = "GeneStructureTools"))
exons <- gtf[gtf$type=="exon"]
g <- BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10::BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10
leafcutter_files <- list.files(system.file("extdata","leafcutter/", package = "GeneStructureTools"),full.names = TRUE)
intron_results <- read.delim(leafcutter_files[grep("per_intron_results.tab", leafcutter_files)], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
leafcutter_summary <- leafcutterTranscriptChangeSummary(intron_results, 
                                                        exons = exons,
                                                        BSgenome = g,
                                                        NMD = FALSE,
                                                        showProgressBar = FALSE)
cluster <- leafcutter_summary[leafcutter_summary$cluster=="chr16:clu_1396",]
altIsoforms1396 <- alternativeIntronUsage(cluster, exons)
altIsoforms1396_dnreg <- altIsoforms1396[grep("dnre", 
                                            altIsoforms1396$transcript_id)]
altIsoforms1396_upreg <- altIsoforms1396[grep("upre", 
                                            altIsoforms1396$transcript_id)]

workflows.name: dexseq_and_gtf_reannotation
workflows.intent: Reannotate GTF features (UTRs and broad biotypes) and overlap DEXSeq results to identify the exonic part types affected by differential usage.
workflows.stages: 1. Import GTF and reannotate UTRs to 5' and 3' UTRs using UTR2UTR53 ;; 2. Reannotate transcript biotypes into broader categories using addBroadTypes ;; 3. Import DEXSeq results and exonic parts ranges ;; 4. Find the exon type of significant DEXSeq events using findDEXexonType ;; 5. Summarize exon types into broader definitions using summariseExonTypes
workflows.code:
gtf <- rtracklayer::import(system.file("extdata","example_gtf.gtf", 
package = "GeneStructureTools"))
gtf_UTRannotated <- UTR2UTR53(gtf)
gtf <- addBroadTypes(gtf)
gtf <- rtracklayer::import(system.file("extdata","example_gtf.gtf", 
package = "GeneStructureTools"))
gtf <- UTR2UTR53(gtf)
dexseq_ranges <- rtracklayer::import(system.file("extdata",
"gencode.vM14.dexseq.gtf", package = "GeneStructureTools"))
dexseq_results.significant <- read.delim(system.file("extdata",
"dexseq_results_significant.txt", package = "GeneStructureTools"))
dexseq_results.significant$overlap_types <- 
findDEXexonType(rownames(dexseq_results.significant), dexseq_ranges, gtf=gtf)
dexseq_results.significant$overlap_types_broad <- summariseExonTypes(dexseq_results.significant$overlap_types)
